visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a person in a bright blue puffer jacket and a black beanie walking away from the camera on a snow-covered urban street in a modern city. The setting features multi-story commercial buildings with yellow and gray geometric accents and a detailed city map kiosk on the left. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting a clear winter day. (2) The scene shifts to the same person walking towards the camera in an urban environment; they are wearing a black mask and a backpack. The camera maintains a medium shot, capturing the snowy ground and the architectural details of the background buildings. (3) The location changes to a busy ski resort slope where numerous skiers and snowboarders are visible in the background. A central figure wearing a white and gray camouflage-patterned ski jacket is viewed from behind, holding a snowboard. Nearby, a yellow building serves as a base station. (4) A character in a vibrant red ski jacket and black helmet stands still in front of a large red Torii gate located in a heavily misted or snowy forest. The contrast between the red gate and the white, foggy background creates a stark, atmospheric scene. (5) The camera captures close-up shots of a person in a light blue ski jacket and goggles, looking directly at the camera while holding their snowboard vertically. (6) The final phase depicts a person in a white ski suit performing a fluid snowboarding maneuver on a groomed slope under a bright blue sky. The camera uses a low-angle tracking shot, finishing with a prominent lens flare as the sun catches the lens.
